definition: Openly showing feelings through words, gestures or physical affection.
author: Louisa May Alcott
quote: Then the Professor thanked him so heartily, and looked so suddenly illuminated with satisfaction, that Laurie thought him the most delightfully demonstrative old fellow he ever met.
example_sentence: Grandad is not demonstrative, but he did once text a heart emoji.
